title: Texas musicians and bands
summary: Names Harry James, Ray McKinley, Jimmy Joy and others from Texas; Alfonso Trent and Boots and His Buddies mentioned.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, you certainly had wonderful bands over there.

Yes, we did. Harry James is from Texas, and Ray McKinley is from Texas, and, uh, Jimmy Joy, of course. Jimmy Maloney played wonderful clarinet. He's from Texas. It turned out some very good boys over there. Oh, we sure did.
Alfonso Trent? Yeah. It's a good band everybody says. I never got a chance to hear it.
